_comentario: Planos independientes: ninguno depende de otro, así que todos paralelizan y cualquiera se rehace solo. Se montan con cortes.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE DEL BUCLE. El cuarto entero desde la puerta: la ventana con lluvia, la lámpara, el gato dormido. Es a donde vuelve P12.
planos.prompt:
WIDE SHOT, hand-painted 2D animated film with soft painterly textures, calm, slow and quiet.
MOTION: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA on a tripod, perfectly still for the whole shot. Only tiny slow ambient motion: rain streaks slide down the window glass, a thin thread of vapour rises from the mug, the sleeping cat's flank rises and falls slowly, the record on the turntable turns slowly, the blurred lights outside shimmer faintly. The lamp light is steady. Nothing else moves. The room stays empty; the wooden chair stays tucked under the desk exactly where it is; the only thing beyond the glass is the dark rainy city with its blurred lights. The rain keeps falling on the window glass for the whole shot, and it stays night outside: the same dark rainy city, the same blurred lights.
FRAMING: hold the exact shot size and composition of the first frame.
CHARACTERS, unchanged from the first frame: a plump grey tabby cat with darker grey stripes, a white chest and white paws, curled up ASLEEP on the folded burgundy wool blanket on the wide windowsill, eyes closed, tail wrapped over its paws; it never wakes up, never stands, never looks at the camera.
AUDIO: [Ambient] The only sounds are a steady soft rain pattering on the window glass, a faint far-away muffled city hum.
Everything in the frame stays exactly as it is in the first frame for the whole shot: the same place, the same objects in the same positions, the same time of night, the same light. The frame holds only what the first frame shows, from beginning to end. Animate only the gentle motion described above; the rest of the picture stays still.
